history.summary: Freehold 3BR dual-key, just-TOP (2025), 300m / 4-min walk to Aljunied MRT (EW9) in D14 at $2.18M / $1793 PSF. Strong location and tenure, but it's an anonymized small-boutique Geylang-fringe listing with zero URA appreciation/transaction data to verify pricing or resale liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine positives: freehold, brand-new, 300m to EW9, dual-key flexibility for rental yield, and Paya Lebar Central catalyst nearby. But the entire technical block is null (no ura_txn_count, no median PSF, no appreciation) — this is a thin, unverifiable boutique with a marketing-spun listing name, typical of small Geylang-fringe FH blocks that are illiquid on exit. $1793 PSF for the location is fair, not cheap. Can't rate Buy without resale comps.
